programme.title: Belan Wali Bahu
programme.desc: Vasundhara Devi is married to Deendayal and has two children, Ashish and Amar, who is her stepson. However, she does not accept Amar and his wife.

programme.title: Aayee Milan Ki Raat
programme.desc: Sameer is in love with Priyanka, but she is possessed by a spirit named Kajal. While uncovering the truth to protect Priyanka, Sameer discovers that Kajal was his partner in a past life.

programme.title: Lalaki Chunariya Odh Ke
programme.desc: A comprehensive compilation of melodious devotional songs performed by talented musicians is played in quick succession.

programme.title: Zakhm
programme.desc: The story revolves around a young boy, Ajay, who grows up torn between his mother's Muslim identity and his father's Hindu beliefs. When his mother is killed in a communal riot, Ajay is forced to confront his past and reconcile his conflicted identity. The film explores themes of love, loss, and communal harmony against the backdrop of religious tensions in India.

programme.title: Ghar Ka Chiraag
programme.desc: A wealthy widower marries the daughter of a school principal when her lover is assumed dead. Years later, her partner returns and sets out to find the truth behind her marriage.

programme.title: Sadma
programme.desc: Sadma (1983) is an emotional drama about a young woman who, after losing her memory and regressing to childhood, is rescued by a kind man who cares for her. As he grows deeply attached to her, fate takes a tragic turn when she regains her memory but forgets him completely.

programme.title: O mama pentru copiii mei
programme.desc: Un om de afaceri milionar, cu trei copii, are nevoie de ajutor pentru a-și îngriji familia. Însă destinul îl aduce față în față cu fosta sa iubită, schimbându-i viața într-o direcție neașteptată.

programme.title: Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham...
programme.desc: În familia Raichand, legăturile sunt sfinte. Când Rahul se îndrăgosteşte de Anjali, lucrurile se schimbă, pentru că fata nu este pe gustul tatălui, Yash. Acesta vrea să-şi însoare fiul cu Naina. Tatăl şi fiul rup relaţiile. Se vor mai revedea ei?

programme.title: The Legend of Bhagat Singh
programme.desc: Filmul spune povestea unui tânăr revoluționar care a condus o grupare de rezistență armată împotriva dominației britanice în India.

programme.title: Dragostea invinge tot
programme.desc: Bhaarat se trezește singur într-o lume pustie și își retrăiește viața: aventurile cu prietenul său Champak, dragostea pentru Kisha și încercarea de a-i dovedi sentimentele, în timp ce ea crede cu tărie în destinul scris în stele...

programme.title: Dincolo de priviri
programme.desc: Sudhir, orb din naștere, locuiește singur cu menajera sa Bhavani. În timp ce Bhavani este plecată, el îl ia pe Ali să îl ajute în casă. Bhavani și Ali devin invidioși unul pe celălalt. Filmul spune povestea comică, dar sinceră, a celor trei.

programme.title: Nascut din otel
programme.desc: Filmul urmărește povestea unor oameni prinși într-un joc periculos al loialității și trădării, într-un oraș plin de tensiuni.

programme.title: Strigatul dreptatii
programme.desc: Un actor popular de la Bollywood asistă la o crimă, dar refuză să iasă în față pentru a identifica criminalul.

programme.title: Flacarile iubirii
programme.desc: O fată bogată și un băiat din clasa de mijloc se iubesc, dar mama vitregă se opune. Fug împreună, ajutați de un avocat. Un asasin trimis să-l omoare descoperă adevărul și îi sprijină pe îndrăgostiți.

programme.title: Trantorul
programme.desc: Un pierde-vară și cumnata lui, o femeie muncitoare și disciplinată, nu se suportă deloc. Dar când un pericol comun le amenință familia, cei doi sunt forțați să lase deoparte diferențele și să lupte împreună.

programme.title: In umbra armelor
programme.desc: Un infractor priceput la tras devine trăgător de elită în competiții, în timp ce prietenul său din copilărie rămâne prins în lumea crimei.

programme.title: Sukhee
programme.desc: Spre disperarea soțului ei, o gospodină din clasa de mijloc, cunoscută pentru atitudinea ei rebelă din liceu, decide să participe la reuniunea de clasă.

programme.title: Partea întunecată a legii
programme.desc: Vijay Salgaonkar, un bărbat cu o condiție modestă și doar 4 clase, mare amator de filme, ajunge sfătuitor justițiar pentru mai multe persoane. Cu ajutorul informațiilor primite din filme el reușește să-și depășească condiția celor 4 clase...

programme.title: Vreau să fiu al tău
programme.desc: Rămas orfan la o vârstă foarte fragedă, un tânăr este luat de un gangster și antrenat să accepte crima ca fiind cariera sa. Într-o zi, el dă peste un copil abandonat și decide să îl adopte. Acest lucru îi schimbă viața, iar el decide să se îndrepte.

programme.title: Iubirea prințesei Jodhaa
programme.desc: O poveste de dragoste din secolul 16 despre căsătoria aranjată dintre un împărat mongol şi o prinţesă din Rajput, pe nume Jodha, se transformă în dragoste reală.

programme.title: In transa
programme.desc: Un speaker motivațional deziluzionat acceptă să devină predicator pentru o corporație aflată în căutarea unui nou suflu spiritual. Însă apariția sa în direct la TV atrage atenția publicului și ridică semne de întrebare asupra sincerității sale...

programme.title: Fratia strazii
programme.desc: Patru prieteni, prinși în lumea interlopă, își pun în pericol viețile personale, ajungând într-un punct fără întoarcere.

programme.title: Hello Hum Lallann Bol Rahe Hain
programme.desc: Un paznic organizează căsătoria femeii pe care o iubește cu alt bărbat.

programme.title: Avere si destin
programme.desc: Kashinath și Imli, iubiți din copilărie, văd cum viața lor se complică când apare Anjali. Dragoste, boală și sacrificii le vor testa relația și devotamentul.

programme.title: Kabhi Alvida Naa Kehna
programme.desc: Dev locuieste in SUA si e fotbalist. E insurat cu Ryna. Dev iai rupe piciorul, dezvolta un handicap si devine dependent de Ryna. Acasa, singur, incepe sa-si faca de lucru, iar apoi incepe s-o suspecteze pe Ryna ca ar avea o aventura cu un alt barbat.

programme.title: Ghulam-E-Musthafa
programme.desc: Un gangster renunță la viața criminală după ce iubita lui este ucisă de rivali, dar șeful său îl forțează să revină pentru o ultimă misiune.

programme.title: Bodyguardul
programme.desc: Bodyguard este un film indian romantic şi de acţiune. Este cel de-al treilea remake al filmului Bodyguard. În rolurile principale îi putem vedea pe Salman Khan şi Kareena Kapoor.

programme.title: Prieteni
programme.desc: Trei bărbați aproape identici devin prieteni buni după ce se cunosc printr-o aplicație online de căutare a sosiei. Totul este distractiv până când unul dintre ei se dovedește a fi un fugar notoriu.

programme.title: Supraviețuitoarea
programme.desc: O tânără se mută în Mumbai după ce își pierde părinții, iar orașul său este distrus în urma conflictelor religioase. Ca să supraviețuiască se angajează în calitate de dansatoare într-un bar.

programme.title: Ce se intampla, draga mea?
programme.desc: O comedie plină de încurcături care străbate zonele rurale din Haryana, dezvăluind relații haotice, situații nebunești și excentricități în rândul familiei, prietenilor, îndrăgostiților și chiar al polițiștilor!

programme.title: Maior la datorie
programme.desc: Filmul este inspirat din viața maiorului Sandeep Unnikrishnan, eroul care a luptat cu curaj în timpul atacurilor teroriste din Mumbai, în noiembrie 2008. O poveste despre sacrificiu, onoare și datoria dusă până la capăt.

programme.title: Pamantul - 1947
programme.desc: În Lahore, 1947, înaintea separării Indiei de Pakistan, un grup de prieteni cu credințe diferite își petrec zilele împreună. După separare, tensiunile cresc, iar tânăra Lenny, alături de dadaca ei Shanta, asistă la destrămarea armoniei din jurul lor.

programme.title: Baazaar
programme.desc: După ce se mută la Mumbai, un tânăr ambițios devine trader de acțiuni pentru un om de afaceri cunoscut pentru activitățile sale dubioase.

programme.title: Steaua de mare
programme.desc: O călătorie frumoasă prin adâncurile lumii subacvatice, în timp ce suntem martorii unei povești captivante despre durere și vindecare care se desfășoară sub ochii noștri.

programme.title: Cantec nevazut
programme.desc: O serie de evenimente misterioase îi schimbă viața unui pianist orb, care acum trebuie să raporteze o crimă despre care, teoretic, nu ar trebui să știe nimic.

programme.title: Ek Anjaan Rishtey Ka Guilt
programme.desc: Saru este căsătorită cu Pratap, ofițer de poliție, însă problemele de intimitate dintre ei creează o ruptură în mariaj. Saru găsește sprijin în Sunil, prietenul din copilărie al soțului ei. Apropierea dintre ei se transformă treptat într-o relație...

programme.title: Sukhee
programme.desc: Spre disperarea soțului ei, o gospodină din clasa de mijloc, cunoscută pentru atitudinea ei rebelă din liceu, decide să participe la reuniunea de clasă.

programme.title: Naqaab
programme.desc: Indragostita de un baiat bogat, Sofia, o tanara din clasa d mijloc, incepe sa il indrageasca pe Vicky...

programme.title: Seful
programme.desc: Boss ia asupra sa vina pentru o crimă comisă din greșeală de tatăl său. După închisoare, devine un gangster temut, dar viața lui ia o turnură periculoasă când un polițist corupt și un politician îi cer să ucidă, punându-l într-o dilemă cumplită.

programme.title: Iubirea prințesei Jodhaa
programme.desc: O poveste de dragoste din secolul 16 despre căsătoria aranjată dintre un împărat mongol şi o prinţesă din Rajput, pe nume Jodha, se transformă în dragoste reală.

programme.title: Trăiește clipa
programme.desc: Desi o iubeste nespus de mult, Aman incearca sa o impinga in bratele prietenului ei cel mai bun, Rohit. Reuseste, iar cand Naina era deja fericita de noua schimbare, afla ca Aman e pe moarte si ca de fapt el s-a sacrificat pentru ea.

programme.title: Auzaar
programme.desc: Yash și Suraj, prieteni buni, urmează drumuri diferite: Yash preia afacerea tatălui său mafiot, iar Suraj devine ofițer CBI. Când tatăl lui Yash este atacat, acesta jură răzbunare, iar Suraj începe o anchetă care le va testa prietenia.

programme.title: మర్యాద రామన్న

programme.title: డివోషనల్ సాంగ్స్
programme.sub-title: A religious leader and devotees sing songs to praise the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality

programme.title: వందేమాతరం సాంగ్
programme.sub-title: A compilation of patriotic songs glorifying the greatness and unity of India and performed by various artists is played back to back
programme.desc: భారతదేశ గొప్పతనాన్ని మరియు ఐక్యతను కీర్తిస్తూ వివిధ కళాకారులు ప్రదర్శించే దేశభక్తి గీతాల త్వరితగతిన ప్రసారం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: నాదస్వరం
programme.sub-title: Professional musicians play classical compositions on the nadaswaram, a traditional South Indian wind instrument, and enthrall the viewers
programme.desc: ప్రొఫెషనల్ సంగీతకారులు ప్రేక్షకులను అలరించడానికి నాదస్వరం అనే పవన వాయిద్యంలో శాస్త్రీయ సంగీతాన్ని వాయిస్తారు.

programme.title: పసిడిపంటలు
programme.sub-title: The host talks about the latest tools, methods and technology used in agriculture and shares helpful and insightful farming tips
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత, వ్యవసాయంలో ఉపయోగించే తాజా సాధనాలు, పద్ధతులు, సాంకేతికతల గురించి మాట్లాడుతుంది, వ్యవసాయ చిట్కాలు పంచుకుంటారు.

programme.title: అర్చన
programme.sub-title: Religious priests and devotees offer prayers and perform sacred rituals to seek the blessings of the Almighty at a place of worship
programme.desc: ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువులు, భక్తులు ఒక పుణ్యక్షేత్రంలో భగవంతుడి కృపాకటాక్షలను కోరుతూ ఆచార వ్యవహారాలతో ప్రత్యేక పూజలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: సంస్కృత్ న్యూస్
programme.sub-title: The host presents the latest updates pertaining to various important current affairs, religious and cultural events in Sanskrit
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత వివిధ ముఖ్యమైన వ్యవహారాలకు చెందిన తాజా వార్తా విశేషాలు, మతపరమైన, సాంస్కృతిక విశేషాలను సంస్కృతంలో అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: మర్యాద రామన్న

programme.desc: తన భూమిని అమ్మడానికి స్వస్థలానికి వచ్చిన రాము, ఒక అమ్మాయితో ప్రేమలో పడతాడు, కానీ ఆమె కుటుంబం అతన్ని చంపాలనుకుంటుంది.

programme.title: డివోషనల్ సాంగ్స్
programme.sub-title: A religious leader and devotees sing songs to praise the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: ఒక ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు, భక్తులు భగవంతుని బోధనలను స్తుతించడానికి పాటలు పాడతారు, ఆధ్యాత్మికత మార్గాన్ని తీసుకోమని కోరతారు.

programme.title: Haunted Towns
programme.sub-title: The team head to the Old Idaho State Penitentiary. Here, they hope to encounter the spirits of two infamous murderers who are rumoured to haunt the building
programme.desc: Founded by a devout Christian after having a paranormal encounter, The Tennessee Wraith Chasers investigate the most haunted towns in the United States. The team employs courage, wits and technology to find the truth behind the mystery.

credits.actor: Chris Smith,Steven McDougal,Scott Porter,Brannon Smith,Mike Goncalves

programme.title: The Face Doctors
programme.sub-title: A simple toothache leads to a deadly flesh-eating infection in Terry's eye, and Anita makes the heartbreaking decision to have one of her eyes removed
programme.desc: Following day-to-day life at Addenbrooke's Hospital, renowned for its cutting-edge support for patients seeking treatment or surgery for conditions that affect the face and neck.

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.sub-title: Sausage rolls, Easter treats, lollipops, and Korean dumplings
programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. Each episode offers a behind-the-scenes view of production lines across the country to find out how some of the most-popular food items are really made. Through the ingredients, techniques and required processes, `Food Factory' reveals how raw ingredients are turned into everyday eats. In what some call a fascinating world, the manufacturing and technology that is being used in factories simplifies how the country gets its food.

programme.title: Factory Made
programme.desc: How to make all kinds of products, from the most common to the most complex.

programme.title: Houdini's Last Secrets
programme.sub-title: How did Harry Houdini pull off his death-defying escapes? A team of experts investigates his illusions to reveal the secrets of this mysterious stunt
programme.desc: Cracking a magician's code used to be strictly against industry standards. Now, it seems the magic has disappeared from that concept, and even legendary performers such as Harry Houdini are not immune. This series looks to uncover the methods to Houdini's breathtaking escapes and astonishing illusions, which have never been equalled or fully understood. How did this showman catch a speeding bullet, submerge himself in a water torture cell, or survive being buried alive? Helping piece together clues and testing out his most daring stunts are Houdini's grand-nephew George Hardeen, magician and daredevil Lee Terbosic, and master stunt builder Steve Wolf.

programme.title: The Face Doctors
programme.sub-title: Kamil has lost half of his nose and needs prosthetist Nigel's help. Plus, surgeon Vijay pieces together Dean's shattered jaw and cheekbone
programme.desc: Following day-to-day life at Addenbrooke's Hospital, renowned for its cutting-edge support for patients seeking treatment or surgery for conditions that affect the face and neck.

programme.title: Harpoon Hunters
programme.sub-title: Captain Joe takes his sons to sea aboard the Redrum, only to witness nature at its rawest. Niko hunts the season's biggest bluefin yet
programme.desc: A crew of elite fishermen harpoon bluefin tuna off the shores of the Northeastern US. The race is on in a hunt that could reel in a fortune.

programme.title: You Have Been Warned
programme.sub-title: The smartest and bravest people use science to take their skills to the next level, including designing underwater biospheres that can grow crops in the sea
programme.desc: Forget everything you thought you knew about science - `Outrageous Acts of Science' proves that testing the principles of physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering isn't confined to just laboratories anymore. The fast-paced series scours the Web for the best self-appointed scientists whose homegrown research - mind-boggling experiments, extraordinary inventions and jaw-dropping scientific stunts - has gone viral. Hour-long episodes count down the best clips, supported by a team of actual scientists who analyse the principles behind the backyard shenanigans.

credits.actor: Alistair Linsell,Timothy Dabado,Helen Arney,Debbie Berebichez,Hakeem Oluseyi,Adam Ruben

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.sub-title: Zak and the crew arrive in historic Pendleton, Oregon, to investigate dark hauntings in its storied subterranean tunnels. Has a history of death, misery and hatred fed the negative energy snaking its way beneath this seemingly peaceful town?
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans leads his team of co-investigators Nick Groff and Aaron Goodwin at haunted locations both in America and abroad, interviewing locals about alleged hauntings before going face to face with supernatural entities. Each hour-long episode follows Bagans, Groff and Goodwin as they work to uncover the paranormal mysteries, and after piecing together the haunted history of each site, the team holds a dusk-to-dawn `lockdown' in an effort to obtain physical evidence of the paranormal and discover the truth.

programme.title: My 600-Lb. Life
programme.sub-title: Jonathan had his dream job, and he ate himself out of it. Once an EMT first responder, now he rarely leaves the room. His wife works full-time to pay their bills, and Jonathan must break the cycle of eating if he wants to keep his wife and his life
programme.desc: Telling powerful stories in hourlong episodes, TLC follows medical journeys of morbidly obese people as they attempt to save their own lives. The featured individuals - each weighing more than 600 pounds (42 stones - confront lifelong emotional and physical struggles as they make the courageous decision to undergo high-risk gastric bypass surgery. In addition to drastically changing their appearances, they hope to reclaim their independence, mend relationships with friends and family, and renew their feelings of self-worth.

programme.title: Bering Sea Gold
programme.sub-title: Shawn has a bold plan to rebuild the Myrtle Irene. Zeke tests out his unique sailboat dredge, and Vernon exams his claim with an underwater drone
programme.desc: The gold rush in Alaska isn't confined to the state's precious ground. It's taking place on the sea ... or more accurately, on the bottom of the frigid Bering Sea. This series, from the creators of the Emmy-winning \"Deadliest Catch,\" follows four gold dredges and their eccentric and driven crews who risk their lives to find as much gold as possible before winter sets in and it's too dangerous to dive. The custom-built rigs, some barely seaworthy, include an 80-foot barge run by the most successful gold dredger in Nome, Alaska, and a modified skiff that seats only two people.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: Part 1
programme.desc: America and Europe in 1491, and why America was discovered and not the other way around.

programme.title: Part 2
programme.desc: The true legacy of Columbus is biological, and it created one world out of two.

programme.title: The Maya
programme.desc: More than 2000 years ago the Maya built gigantic cities in the middle of the jungle of Central America. They were brilliant inventors and set standards in writing, mathematics and astronomy.

programme.title: The Aztecs
programme.desc: The Aztecs: Within a very short time they created a huge empire, whose metropolis was a perfectly organized floating garden city on the Mexican plateau.

programme.title: The Incas
programme.desc: The Incas appear out of nowhere and within a few decades their empire develops into the largest empire in the world at the time.

programme.title: First Before Columbus
programme.desc: To many, Columbus is the man who discovered America. Yet, there had been others before him. This is their story!

programme.title: Heliopolis - The City of the Sun
programme.desc: A German-Egyptian team is looking for traces of the largest temple of the pharaohs in the middle of Cairo and for answers as to why the sanctuary was abandoned more than 2000 years ago.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Greeks Changed the World
programme.desc: Ancient Greece – the cradle of modern Europe. Around 3000 years ago, the cultural foundations of western civilisation were laid right here, on the shores of the Mediterranean. It’s the birthplace of democracy, where great thinkers forged the beginnings of scientific reasoning, where theatre was turned into mass entertainment, and where the Olympic Games began. Imaginative animation, stunning visuals and an entertaining narrative combine in an extraordinary exploration of Greece and the rise of an ancient super-power that would leave a permanent mark on western society.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Romans Changed the World
programme.desc: The Romans created one of the greatest empires in history, built with the help of an incredible army of professional legionnaires and a well-oiled political machinery. At its height, a few hundred men ruled over a fifth of mankind and an area stretching from Britain to Syria and from Gibraltar to the Euphrates. They undertook some of the most ambitious building projects of their time: endless roads, gigantic bridges and imposing aqueducts formed a complex infrastructure and left a lasting legacy. This film is a revelatory and unique journey into the world of ancient Rome.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Vikings Changed the World
programme.desc: This episode explores the Vikings not as ruthless raiders but as groundbreaking seafarers, traders, and explorers. Master shipbuilders, they forged vast networks of commerce stretching from Europe to Asia and even reached the shores of America centuries before Columbus. By challenging the stereotype of violent marauders, the documentary presents the Vikings as a tolerant and skilled people whose innovations in navigation and trade reshaped medieval exploration and left an enduring mark on global history.

programme.title: The Fall of Judea
programme.desc: The Fatal Conflict Episode 2 explores the events that shaped the great Jewish revolt against Rome, as recorded by Jewish General, historian and perceived traitor, Flavius Josephus.

programme.title: Birth of a Brotherhood
programme.desc: At the beginning of the 12th century, a few knights decide to create a new brotherhood called "The order of the Temple".

programme.title: A business empire
programme.desc: In the middle of the 12th century, the order of the Temple becomes increasingly popular among the kings and peoples of Western Europe.

programme.title: The fall of the order
programme.desc: At the end of the 13th century, as Christian holdings in the holy land have disappeared, the Templars continue to push for a new crusade.

programme.title: In the Footsteps of Jesus
programme.desc: For the past 2000 years, he has remained the most famous character of History. Described as a leader, as a feminist, an anarchist, a healer. But today, what do we really know about Jesus?

programme.title: The Miracles of Jesus
programme.desc: For more than 2000 years, he has been the most discussed character in History. What do we really know about Jesus today?

programme.title: The Quest for the Ark of the Covenant
programme.desc: In Judaism, it’s the most sacred object. A chest carved in acacia wood, gilded with gold leaf, and topped by two cherubs. The Ark of the Covenant strikes down the Mortal who touches it.

programme.title: The Quest for the Grail
programme.desc: It’s the most desired and sacred relic in Christianity. However, this artefact is shrouded in mystery. No one can say what it looks like. Today, dozens of churches claim to hold the Grail.

programme.title: The Power of King Solomon
programme.desc: Solomon is a mythical figure of the Old Testament. Third king of Israel, he reigned from 970 to 931 BC. But did he really exist?

programme.title: The Mystery of Fátima
programme.desc: The Shrine of Fatima in Portugal is one of the most visited pilgrimage sites in the world. More than 6 million visitors come every year to take a moment in this place.

programme.title: Camp Century
programme.desc: In 1959 the USA decided to build a military town under the ice sheet of North Greenland. The superpower wanted to use all its might to gain a strategic advantage over the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Life behind the Walls of Europe's Castles
programme.desc: What was life like behind a castle walls? The documentary follows their development from simple wooden fortifications to the most elaborate strongholds and residences.

programme.title: Enemy at the Gate
programme.desc: Castles were bastions of power. Yet, what if the enemy was at the gates? Our documentary examines the military function of castles from the 11th to the 16th century.

programme.title: Tinderbox Yugoslavia
programme.desc: Under the influence of changing rulers and empires, the country’s structure is formed over centuries as home to five nationalities with three languages and four different religions.

programme.title: A State Falls Apart
programme.desc: We are in the fateful year of Yugoslavia’s first free elections since World War II: 1990. It is the hour of the nationalists.

programme.title: The Balkans in Flames
programme.desc: The documentary THE BALKANS IN FLAMES examines the disintegration of the former Socialist Federation of Yugoslavia.

programme.title: The Rise of Judea
programme.desc: The Rise of Judea explores the tumultuous reign of King Herod and the ascent of Roman stewardship in Judea through the words of Flavius Josephus.

programme.title: The Fall of Judea
programme.desc: The Fatal Conflict Episode 2 explores the events that shaped the great Jewish revolt against Rome, as recorded by Jewish General, historian and perceived traitor, Flavius Josephus.

programme.title: Before the Devil Knows You're Dead
programme.desc: Andy (Philip Seymour Hoffman), a debt-ridden broker, needs some quick cash. He ropes his younger brother, Hank (Ethan Hawke), into a scheme to commit the perfect crime: to rob their parents' (Albert Finney, Rosemary Harris) jewelry store. The scheme goes horribly awry, and the family patriarch takes justice into his own hands, unaware that the criminals he is hunting are his own sons.

programme.title: Donnie Darko
programme.desc: In a funny, moving and distinctly mind-bending journey through suburban America, one extraordinary but disenchanted teenager is about to take Time's Arrow for a ride. After surviving a freak accident, Donnie (Jake Gyllenhaal) begins to explore what it means to be alive, and in short order to be in love, he uncovers secrets of the universe that give him a tempting power to alter time and destiny.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.desc: Here today, gone tomorrow. Thousands of people go missing in the United States each year, leaving behind only a mystery without any clues. Their stories are told in `Disappeared' through the voices of family, friends and investigators trying to solve the case, with each hourlong episode recounting the final stages that led to a person's disappearance. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unravelling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects - and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: True Conviction
programme.desc: Anna-Sigga Nicolazzi examines cases through the eyes of a prosecutor and shares her insights into how the complex threads of a murder investigation come together in the courtroom.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans leads his team of co-investigators Nick Groff and Aaron Goodwin at haunted locations both in America and abroad, interviewing locals about alleged hauntings before going face to face with supernatural entities. Each hour-long episode follows Bagans, Groff and Goodwin as they work to uncover the paranormal mysteries, and after piecing together the haunted history of each site, the team holds a dusk-to-dawn `lockdown' in an effort to obtain physical evidence of the paranormal and discover the truth.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: An exploration into the dangers of meeting up with strangers through Internet dating sites. Featuring stories from families and friends of victims who have fallen victim to online predators.

programme.title: Hollywood Demons
programme.desc: Revealing dark realities behind fame's glittering facade from cursed dynasties.

programme.title: Mother, May I Murder?
programme.desc: When the relationship between mothers and their children becomes a breeding ground for conspiracy, manipulation and murder, this toxic bond leaves a trail of misery and destruction throughout America.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes
programme.desc: Following real-life murder investigation as it is being conducted in real time, using raw and unfiltered footage, including body-cam and surveillance footage, to bring out the truth.

programme.desc: 50 வயதான நிதி ஆலோசகரான நந்து, தனது எதிரியைத் தேடிச் செல்லும் பயணத்தில், கடந்த காலச் செயல்களால் மனப்போராட்டத்திற்கு உள்ளாகிறார். அந்தப் பயணம், அவரது அகத்தின் போராட்டத்தையும் இருண்ட முடிவுகளையும் ஆழமாக ஆராயும் ஒரு சுய-சிந்தனைப் பயணமாக அமைகிறது.

credits.actor: Chandru (Nandu),Anandha Krishnan (Nandu),Parthiban Radhakrishnan (Nandu),Sai Priyanka Ruth (Parvathy),Brigida (Chilakkama),Varalaxmi Sarathkumar (Prema kumari),Robo Shankar (Premanandha),Sneha (Lakshmi)

programme.title: Maqbool
programme.desc: In Mumbai's criminal underworld, the lord of all lords is Jahangir Khan (Pankaj Kapoor). Those loyal to him include Maqbool (Irfan Khan), his chief. But Maqbool is in love with Nimmi (Tabu), Jahangir's mistress, who convinces him to be ambitious and take over the empire. After maneuvering potential rivals out of the way, Maqbool betrays Jahangir, murdering him in his own bed. However, it isn't long before both Maqbool and Nimmi are haunted by the ghosts of their treacherous deeds.

programme.title: Nh10
programme.desc: Gurgaon professionals Meera and Arjun are shaken after Meera survives a brutal attack. Seeking escape, they take a desert holiday, but at a highway dhaba they witness hoodlums abducting a young girl.

programme.title: Kitne Door Kitne Paas
programme.desc: After studying in New York City, Jatin (Fardeen Khan) is returning home to India, where he's set to marry a woman from his hometown. On his flight to Delhi, he meets Karishma (Amrita Arora), coincidentally on her way to her own marriage, and her quick temper instantly sets them at odds. Once in Delhi, the unlikely travel companions find their connecting flight has been cancelled, so Jatin and Karishma must share a long bus ride to Gujarat, discovering each other and themselves in the process.

programme.title: Once Upon Time In Mumbai Doobara
programme.desc: A gripping gangster film set in a world of crime and deceit. The story follows the battle for control of Mumbai between notorious gangster Shoaib and ambitious youth Aslam, as they navigate love, loyalty, and betrayal. With explosive action and unforgettable characters, this high-stakes journey takes you deep into the heart of the criminal underworld, where only the strongest will emerge victorious.

programme.title: Secrets of the Elephants
programme.desc: The narrator captures the activities of elephants living in the scorching desert and studies their physical and psychological behaviour.

programme.title: Cobra Mafia
programme.desc: The host presents the behavioural and physical features of the king cobras, forest cobras, white cobras and the Indo-Chinese spitting cobras, highlighting their geographical presence.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: The narrator sheds light on Africa's vast wetlands that are a refuge and lifeline for many animals and how they use the environment to execute the perfect kill.

programme.title: King of The Mountain Baboons
programme.desc: The filmmaker explores the lives and survival tactics of the groups of mountain baboons residing in the highlands of Ethiopia.

programme.title: Leopard Kingdom
programme.desc: Karula, a leopard, has reigned over the Sabi Sand Reserve for over a decade, and before she passed, she had endured much of nature's challenges. Now, one of her daughters must take over the throne.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: When the savannah turns into a vicious battleground filled with bloodshed and gore, it becomes difficult to choose a hero.

programme.title: Predator v Prey
programme.desc: Leopards hunt a wide array of prey, including impala, catfish, and storks, which reveals new insights into their killer-ambush strategies.

programme.title: Tree Climbing Lions
programme.desc: A wildlife biologist examines a rare group of lions that reside on top of trees in the Queen Elizabeth National Park of Uganda, Africa.

programme.title: Big Cat Planet
programme.desc: The filmmaker explores the resilience and versatility of big cats for survival, highlighting their capacity to adapt and their ability to respond effectively to unexpected challenges.

programme.title: Death at the River
programme.desc: The filmmaker takes a journey along the rivers, where different species of animals fight for their survival and prove their resilience.

programme.title: Queens
programme.desc: Bear and orca queens use their well-worn experience and lethal instincts in order to protect the families and ensure their survival.

programme.title: Mashatu: Land of Leopard
programme.desc: The filmmaker follows the life journey of a mother leopard with her two cubs, fighting to survive on parched land in Botswana.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: As the dry winter looms ahead of their days, lethal lions & wild buffaloes battle it out around the last remaining water.

programme.title: Cat Attack-Tics
programme.desc: The filmmaker explores the extraordinary tactics and killer instincts of the deadliest wild cats, from leopards to jaguars and beyond.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: The filmmaker captures unique footage of animals engaging in dangerous fights in order to thrive in the precarious conditions of the wilderness.

programme.title: Diary of a Teen Leopard
programme.desc: Pemba, a young leopard, learns to fend for himself after an injury leaves his overprotective mother unable to hunt. Meanwhile, he navigates the wild alone.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: The filmmakers explore the prey-catching methods of some of Africa's deadliest predators, from the Ethiopian wolf's hunting tactics to the Verreaux's eagle's high-speed aerial pursuits.

programme.title: Hippo vs. Croc
programme.desc: The filmmakers explore the lives of two of the deadliest species of Africa, hippopotamuses and crocodiles, and how they have survived side by side.

programme.title: Cheetah: The Maasai Brotherhood
programme.desc: The filmmaker sheds light on the Tana Bora, an alliance of five cheetahs who have grown into a formidable hunting unit that takes down large prey and survives super predators of the savannah.

programme.title: Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara
programme.desc: Rival crocodile clans on the Grumeti and Mara rivers engage in a fierce struggle for dominance as the great migration brings new opportunities and challenges.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: Animals adopt various survival techniques and defense mechanisms in order to safeguard their younger ones and substantiate the existence of their descent.

programme.title: Snake Attack-Tics
programme.desc: The filmmaker sheds light on different species of snakes and their lethal hunting strategies, ambush tactics and specialised attack manoeuvres to capture and overpower prey of all sizes.

programme.title: Jaguars vs. Crocs
programme.desc: In a dense forest, a mighty jaguar leaves no stone unturned to cleverly hunt down its prey and satisfy its beastly hunger.

programme.title: Secrets of the Elephants
programme.desc: The filmmaker explores various parts of the world in order to learn about the lives and inner workings of different sets of elephants.

programme.title: ரிலீஜியஸ் ப்ரோக்ராம்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the teachings of the Almighty to enlighten the devotees and guide them on a path of spiritual growth
programme.desc: மத தலைவர் பக்தர்களுக்கு அறிவூட்டவும், ஆன்மீக பாதையில் வழிநடத்தவும் தேவனின் போதனைகள் குறித்த சொற்பொழிவை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs and hymns in praise of the divine written by various artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட தெய்வீகத்தைப் போற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்கள் மேலும் கீர்த்தனைகள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: கந்தசஷ்டிக்கவசம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of religious hymns and devotional songs in praise of Lord Murugan written by various artists
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட அப்பன் முருகனைப் புகழ்ந்து மத பாடல்கள் மற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: தினம் தினம் தரிசனம்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and spiritual significance of various Hindu temples and pilgrimage shrines across India
programme.desc: இந்தியா முழுவதும் உள்ள பல்வேறு இந்து கோவில்கள் மற்றும் புனித யாத்திரை தலங்களின் மத மற்றும் ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவம்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு சஹஸ்ரநாமம்
programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees chant a Sanskrit hymn listing the 1,000 names of Lord Vishnu to seek his divine blessings
programme.desc: இந்து மதத் தலைவர்களும் பக்தர்களும் விஷ்ணுவின் 1,000 நாமங்களைக் கொண்ட சமஸ்கிருத பாடலைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஜி‌கே‌பி / பி‌பி / டி‌டி‌எல்‌எம்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: தொலைக்காட்சியில் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருதல்.

programme.title: மதுரை காளியம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees gather at a pious shrine to offer their sincere prayers, worship the Almighty and seek divine blessings
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் சன்னதியில் கூடி தங்கள் பிரார்த்தனைகளை வழங்கி, இறைவனை வணங்கி, தெய்வீக ஆசீகளைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு ஷேத்திரம்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees assemble to perform a ceremonial ritual, offering worship and seeking the divine blessings of Lord Vishnu
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் கூடி, ஒரு சடங்கு சடங்கை செய்து, வழிபாடு செய்து, விஷ்ணுவின் தெய்வீக ஆசீர்வாதத்தைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: பக்தி பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular devotional songs in praise of deities performed by eminent artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் நடத்தப்படும் தெய்வங்களைப் போற்றும் பிரபலமான பக்திப் பாடல்கள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: சத்குரு
programme.sub-title: Sadhguru, a spiritual guru, gives a discourse on the teachings from the scriptures and urges his followers to walk on the path of righteousness
programme.desc: வேதங்களிலிருந்து போதனைகள் பற்றிய சொற்பொழிவை வழங்கி, பக்தர்களை நீதியின் பாதையில் செல்ல தூண்டும் ஆன்மீக குருவான சத்குரு.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீமத் பாகவதம்
programme.sub-title: A Hindu priest from Tirumala explains the chapters from Bhagavata Purana to the devotees of Lord Krishna in a detailed manner
programme.desc: ஆன்மீகத் தலைவர் ஆழ்ந்த ஞானத்தைப் பகிர்ந்து இந்து கடவுளான கிருஷ்ணரின் வாழ்க்கையை விவரிக்கும் தகவல் உரையை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: அம்மன் கோவில்கள்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and cultural significance of various temples and shrines dedicated to Goddess Amman
programme.desc: தேவி அம்மனுக்கான பல்வேறு கோவில்கள் மற்றும் சன்னதிகளின் மத மற்றும் கலாச்சார முக்கியத்துவத்தை எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது.

programme.title: இஷ்ட தெய்வம்
programme.sub-title: Renowned individuals extensively discuss their faith and share experiences of divine providence and miracles in their personal lives
programme.desc: தங்கள் நம்பிக்கையை பற்றி பேசுவதோடு, அவர்களின் வாழ்வில் தெய்வீக நம்பிக்கை-அற்புதங்கள் பற்றிய அனுபவங்களை பகிரும் நபர்கள்.

programme.title: சிவாலயம்
programme.sub-title: At a revered temple in Kerala, priests and devotees unite in devotion, performing sacred rituals and offering heartfelt prayers to Lord Shiva

programme.title: Lynyrd Skynyrd
programme.sub-title: Live From The Florida Theater
programme.desc: Earlier this year Lynyrd Skynyrd performed their first two studio albums, “Pronounced ‘Lĕh-'nérd ‘Skin-'nérd” and “Second Helping”, live in their entirety for the first time, at two specially staged concerts at the Florida Theatre in their home town of Jacksonville, Florida. It was a special occasion for both the act and their fans as the band performed tracks they'd never or rarely played live before alongside classic songs that are an essential part of any Lynyrd Skynyrd live show. These unique concerts are a must have for any Lynyrd Skynyrd fan.

programme.title: The Doobie Brothers
programme.sub-title: Live At Wolf Trap
programme.desc: Filmed in high definition on 25 July 2004 at Wolf Trap National Park for the Performing Arts in Virginia, "Live At Wolf Trap" captures The Doobie Brothers in fine form on a set that mixes classic hits with some rarely performed tracks from across their extensive catalogue. This would prove to be the last recorded footage of long time drummer Keith Knudsen performing with the Doobie Brothers prior to his sad death from cancer in February 2005.

programme.title: फुल्लू
programme.sub-title: Phullu's mother decides to marry him off to make him more mature. Things take an unexpected turn when he learns about menstruation after marriage
programme.desc: शादी के बाद फुल्लू नाम के एक अशिक्षित व्यक्ति को मासिक धर्म के दौरान महिलाओं को होने वाली समस्याओं का एहसास होता है। इसके बाद, वह इस मुद्दे के बारे में जागरूकता फैलाने का फैसला करता है।.

credits.actor: Sharib Hashmi,Jyoti Sethi,Nutan Surya,Trisha Kale,Kimti Anand,Namya Saxena

programme.title: छोटे सरकार
programme.sub-title: Amar, a rich businessman, is framed by two undercover police officers, Seema and Jagmohan, for the murder of his uncle. To evade prison, he claims to be of unsound mind and tries to solve the mystery
programme.desc: एक व्यापारी, अमर को दो पुलिस अधिकारी, सीमा और जगमोहन अपने चाचा की हत्या के लिए फँसाते हैं। सच का पता लगाने के लिए वो पागल होने का नाटक करता है।.

credits.actor: Govinda,Shilpa Shetty,Divya Dutta,Aruna Irani,Sadashiv Amrapurkar,Kader Khan,Aasif Sheikh

programme.title: जैसी करनी वैसी भरनी
programme.sub-title: A conniving son throws his aged parents out of the house. Years later, he meets the same fate when his son decides to teach him a lesson
programme.desc: एक लालची बेटा, अपने वृद्ध माता पिता को घर से बाहर निकाल देता है। वर्षों बाद, उसका बेटा उसे सबक सिखाने का फैसला करता है और उसे घर के बाहर निकालता है।.

credits.actor: Govinda,Kimi Katkar,Shakti Kapoor,Kader Khan,Asrani,Gulshan Grover,Shoma Anand

programme.title: रोटी
programme.sub-title: Mangal Singh escapes prison and begins a new life, unknowingly befriending his victim's family. As he seeks redemption, his past catches up, compelling him to confront his previous misdeeds
programme.desc: मंगल सिंह जेल से भाग जाता है और एक नया जीवन शुरू करता है और अनजाने में अपने पीड़ित परिवार से दोस्ती कर लेता है। वह खुद को सुधारने की कोशिश करता है पर उसे अपने पिछले कुकर्मों का सामना करना पड़ता है।.

credits.actor: Rajesh Khanna (Mangal Singh),Mumtaz (Bijli),Nirupa Roy (Malti),Sujit Kumar (Police Inspector),Jagdeep (Khadak Singh),Om Prakash (Lalaji)

programme.title: मेरा मुक़द्दर
programme.sub-title: Shanti and Suraj lead a content life until he abandons her to marry Ruchi. Shanti and Ruchi both give birth to boys, who grow up and fight each other, unaware that they are half-brothers
programme.desc: शांति का पति सूरज, उसे और उसके नवजात बच्चे को छोड़ देता है, और रुचि से शादी करता है, जो एक लड़के को जन्म देती है। जब लड़के बड़े होते है, वें बिना सच जाने एक दूसरे के साथ लड़ाई करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Kulbhushan Kharbanda,Aruna Irani,Tanuja,Gulshan Grover,Prem Chopra,Shakti Kapoor

programme.title: राजाजी
programme.sub-title: Raja, a young man, wants an easy life and marries for wealth and comfort. He soon finds out that there is an underlying secret of his wife and feels trapped
programme.desc: राजा, आरामदायक जीवन व्यतीत करने के लिए एक करोड़पति की बेटी, पायल से शादी करता है। लेकिन जब उसे पता चलता है कि वह वास्तव में करोड़पति के माली की बेटी है, तो वह उसे छोड़ देता है।.

credits.actor: Govinda,Raveena Tandon,Shakti Kapoor,Ranjeet,Mohan Joshi,Divya Dutta,Satish Kaushik,Aruna Irani,Kader Khan,Dinesh Hingoo,Mushtaq Khan,Guddi Maruti

programme.title: थोड़ी थोड़ी सी मनमानियाँ
programme.sub-title: Raised by his mother alone, Siddharth dreams of settling in a foreign country. As part of a rock band, Siddharth enters a competition that changes his life
programme.desc: सिद्धार्थ की परवरिश एकल माँ द्वारा हुई है और वह विदेश में बसना चाहता है। वह संगीत प्रतियोगिता में भाग लेता है, एक लोक-गायिका और सामाजिक कार्यकर्ता, नेहा से प्यार होने पर उसका जीवन बदलता है।.

credits.actor: Mukesh Tiwari,Shrenu Parikh,Shilpa Tulaskar,Abhinav Parashar,Karim Hajee,Kuldeep Sareen,Rajeev Sharma,Arsh Sehrawat

programme.title: झूठी
programme.sub-title: Kalpana, a habitual liar, attempts to sabotage her sister's arranged marriage to a doctor, but complications arise when she develops feelings for him
programme.desc: एक युवा महिला, रेखा झूठ बोलने की आदि है। उसका मानना है कि सच बोलना हमेशा अच्छा नहीं होता है। यह रवैया कई बार उसे मुसीबत में डाल देता है।.

credits.actor: Rekha,Raj Babbar,Amol Palekar,Supriya Pathak,Prema Narayan,Madan Puri,Gopi Desai,Goga Kapoor,Rasik Dave,Shammi Kapur,Dina Pathak,Manmauji,Suresh Chatwal,Chandrakant Thakkar,Ajit Vachani

programme.title: डांस डांस
programme.sub-title: Two siblings, Radha and Ramu, belong to a poor family. Their life takes an unexpected turn when a tragic incident leaves them orphaned
programme.desc: दो अनाथ बच्चे, राधा और रामू पैसे कमाने के लिए सड़कों पर गीत गाकर नृत्य करते हैं और बड़े होकर लोकप्रिय कलाकार बनते हैं। लेकिन, राधा की मृत्यु के बाद रामू शराबी बनने से प्रदर्शन करने में असमर्थ रहता है।.

credits.actor: Mithun Chakraborty (Ramu 'Romeo'),Smita Patil (Radha),Mandakini (Janita),Shakti Kapoor (Resham),Amrish Puri (Raja Bahadur A.M. Singh),Om Shivpuri (David Brown)

programme.title: सोल्जर
programme.sub-title: After Major Vijay Malhotra's colleagues betray him, he is branded as a traitor and subsequently killed. But his son, Vicky, vows to take revenge on his father's murderers and prove his innocence
programme.desc: मेजर विजय मल्होत्रा के साथियों द्वारा विश्वासघात के बाद, उन्हें देशद्रोही बोल मार दिया जाता है। लेकिन उनका बेटा विक्की अपने पिता के हत्यारों से बदला लेने और उसकी बेगुनाही साबित करने की कसम खाता है।.

credits.actor: Bobby Deol (Vicky),Preity Zinta (Preity),Raakhee Gulzar (Geeta Malhotra),Farida Jalal (Shanti Sinha),Johnny Lever (Mohan / Sohan),Suresh Oberoi (Subedar Pratap Singh),Dilip Tahil (Virender Sinha),Sharat Saxena (Baldev Sinha),Ashish Vidhyarthi (Dinesh Kapoor),Salim Ghouse (Jaswant),Sheetal Suvarnaa,Jeetu Verma,Kulbhushan Kharbanda,Pankaj Dheer (Vijay Malhotra),Amrut Patel

programme.title: अचानक
programme.sub-title: A man is determined to prove his lover's innocence after she is suddenly accused of murdering his family
programme.desc: अर्जुन पूजा से प्यार करता है और जिन्दगी से बहुत खुश है. तभी किस्मत के खेल से उसकी जिन्दगी ऐसे बदल जाती है, जो उसने सोचा न था .

credits.actor: Govinda,Manisha Koirala,Farha Naaz,Rahul Roy,Johnny Lever,Paresh Rawal

programme.title: अचानक
programme.sub-title: A man is determined to prove his lover's innocence after she is suddenly accused of murdering his family
programme.desc: अर्जुन पूजा से प्यार करता है और जिन्दगी से बहुत खुश है. तभी किस्मत के खेल से उसकी जिन्दगी ऐसे बदल जाती है, जो उसने सोचा न था .

credits.actor: Govinda,Manisha Koirala,Farha Naaz,Rahul Roy,Johnny Lever,Paresh Rawal

programme.title: शिवा
programme.sub-title: Shiva, a VAC College newcomer, opposes an aggressive student leader and violent thugs to secure his campus. Therefore, he acts
programme.desc: वीएसी कॉलेज के नए छात्र शिवा को छात्र संघ अध्यक्ष और गुंडों के एक समूह के खिलाफ खड़ा होना पड़ता है, जिन्होंने कॉलेज के माहौल को हिंसक बना दिया है।.

programme.title: विश्वनाथ
programme.sub-title: Vishwanath, an honest lawyer, is framed and imprisoned due to a gangster. After his release, he sets out to seek revenge and ends up becoming a criminal
programme.desc: एक ईमानदार वकील, विश्वनाथ को एक गैंगस्टर की वजह से फंसाया जाता है और जेल भेजा जाता है। अपनी रिहाई के बाद, वह बदला लेने का निश्चय करता है और अंततः अपराधी बन जाता है।.

credits.actor: Shatrughan Sinha,Reena Roy,Bharat Bhushan,Rita Bhaduri,Sulochana Latkar,Parikshit Sahni,Premnath,Sudhir,Pran,Madan Puri,Satyendra Kapoor,Iftikhar

programme.title: दीवाना तेरे नाम का
programme.sub-title: Friends Shankar and Shambhu share a lot in common and also end up falling in love with the same girl. However, when the girl loves Shankar, Shambhu parts ways with him and joins his rival
programme.desc: दोस्त, शंकर और शंभू में बहुत कुछ समान है और उन्हें एक ही लड़की से प्यार होता है। जब लड़की शंकर से प्यार करती है, तो शंभू उससे दोस्ती तोड़ देता है और विरोधी के साथ शामिल होता है।.

credits.actor: Mithun Chakraborty,Vijayata Pandit,Danny Denzongpa,Jagdeep,Seema Deo,Kamal Kapoor,Yunus Parvez,Sharat Saxena,Jugal Kishore

programme.title: स्वर्ग से सुंदर
programme.sub-title: Two brothers struggle to keep their family together as external forces like the younger brother's father-in-law try to break them apart
programme.desc: छोटे भाई के ससुर जैसी बाहरी ताकतें उन्हें तोड़ने की कोशिश करती हैं तो दो भाई अपने परिवार को एकजुट रखने के लिए संघर्ष करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Jeetendra,Jayapradha,Mithun Chakraborty,Padmini Kolhapure,Asrani,Aruna Irani,Prem Chopra,Kader Khan,Shoma Anand,Satyendra Kapoor

programme.title: क्या यही प्यार है
programme.sub-title: Rahul falls in love with Sandhya, a fellow college student, but realises that she does not reciprocate his feelings. Undeterred by her rejection, he still pursues her but pays a huge price for it
programme.desc: बेहद आक्रामक और अपमानजनक पुलिस अधिकारी, संध्या के पिता, राहुल को गिरफ़्तार कराते है जो संध्या से एकतरफा प्यार करता है। उसका भाई उसकी जमानत कराता है लेकिन राहुल, वहीं दोहराने से बड़ी कीमत चुकाता है।.

credits.actor: Aftab Shivdasani,Ameesha Patel,Jackie Shroff,Ashish Vidyarthi,Neena Kulkarni,Anupama Verma,Vrajesh Hirjee,Sarfaraz Khan

programme.sub-title: Shankar comes across Namkeen and discovers that she resembles Mohinidevi, a millionaire who has gone missing. Sensing an opportunity to acquire riches, he asks Namkeen to impersonate Mohinidevi
programme.desc: शंकर की मुलाकात नमकीन से होती है जो करोडों की मालकिन मोहिनीदेवी की हमशक्ल है, और लापता हो चुकी है। धनवान बनने का मौका देखकर, वह नमकीन से मोहिनीदेवी का रूप धारण करने को कहता है।.

programme.desc: शेखर एक अमीर महिला, दीपा को सबक सिखाने के लिए उसकी हमशक्ल से मिलता है और उसे दीपा का भेस अपनाने के लिए मनाता है। हालात बदतर होते है, जब हमशक्ल को पता चलता है कि दीपा उसकी जुड़वाँ बहन है।.

programme.title: Les McCann
programme.sub-title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record. McCann moves comfortably from one jazz style to the next, demonstrating impressive chops in all areas, from bop to fusion, and from vocals to the keys of the electric piano, clavinet, or synthesizer. His mix of church and swing music captures the spirit of the time perfectly, even when an illness prevented him from playing with more than one finger at a time in the early 1990s. In today's broadcast, McCann takes gospel back to New Orleans, where he played this set in 1983. McCann's vocals shine in the soulful performances of several of his hits, including “Just Like Magic”, backed by his wonderful “Magic Band” of saxophonist Bobby Bryant Jr., bassist Curtis Robertson Jr., and drummer Tony St. James.

programme.title: Omar Sosa, Childo Tomas, Ernesto Simpson & Leandro Saint-Hill
programme.sub-title: Omar Sosa - Quarteto Afrocubano
programme.desc: While always keeping one foot firmly anchored in the traditions of his home country, Cuba, Omar Sosa tirelessly explores music from the Caribbean to India, and West Africa to the Arab world. Since he left Cuba in 1993, the pianist has been blending his Afro-Cuban roots with jazz, hip hop, electro and world music. For his 2018 performance at Théâtre de Villefranche-sur-Saône, he brings to stage his Quarteto Afrocubano members Childo Tomas (electric bass & vocals), Ernesto Simpson (drums), and Leandro Saint-Hill (saxophones, flute, percussion & vocals). Together, they create a riveting instrumental dialogue. Celebrating rhythm in all its forms, this Omar Sosa concert is an intense and mystical experience.

programme.title: Mike Stern
programme.sub-title: Mike Stern & Didier Lockwood: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Guitarist Mike Stern and violin player Didier Lockwood sharing a stage: that promises a good show! After playing for years with Blood, Sweat & Tears, Mike Stern landed a gig with drummer Billy Cobham and then broke through with Miles Davis' comeback band in the 1980s. Didier Lockwood played in jazz fusion band Magma during the 1970s and is known for his use of electric amplification and experimentation. Together they perform a unique duo concert at the beautiful antique theatre in Vienne, France.

programme.title: Joe Turner, Kenny Clarke, Don Byas & Art Simmons
programme.sub-title: Joe Turner - Jazz Marmalade
programme.desc: This vintage program, ‘Jazz Marmalade', shows expatriate American musicians plying their trade in two Parisian jazz clubs in 1962. First, American stride pianist Joe Turner (often confused with blues shouter ‘Big' Joe Turner) opens this atmospheric broadcast with a swinging piano-bass duet recorded at the Mars Club. Joe Turner (1907–1990) would remain in Paris for the rest of his life. From the American-owned Mars Club just off the Champs-Élysées, a hangout for showbiz people and expatriate Americans in Paris, the program cuts to the Blue Note. There, a Paris-based American quartet that includes drummer Kenny Clarke, organ player Lou Bennett, and tenor saxophonist Don Byas performs ‘Salut Les Copines'. Returning to the Mars Club, the American jazz trio of house pianist Art Simmons (1926–2018) performs a jaunty take on ‘C-Jam Blues'. Rounding off the program at the Blue Note, the quartet of drummer Kenny Clarke, organist Lou Bennett, and tenor saxophonist Don Byas returns for a swinging ‘April in Paris'. These recordings offer an invaluable glimpse into expatriate American jazz-making in Paris in the early 1960s.

programme.title: Chick Corea, John Patitucci & Dave Weckl
programme.sub-title: Chick Corea Akoustic Band - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1989, American pianist Armando Anthony "Chick" Corea was one of the artists appearing here. In this concert Corea returned to his roots, performing jazz standards and originals in a stripped-down trio setting of piano, bass and drums. With Dave Weckl (drums) and John Patitucci (bass), this highly interactive trio actually had its beginnings in 1985 with Chick Corea's Elektric Band.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.sub-title: Lorena's Tango
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.sub-title: I want to talk about you
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist's career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: Kusawa Lake: Southern Yukon
programme.desc: Take the dock to a fresh, glacier-fed alpine lake in majestic Yukon.

programme.title: A Day in Paradise
programme.desc: A graciously flowing four hour long pure nature relaxation experience, "A Day In Paradise" immerses viewers in the sights and sounds of one of the world's most pure and picturesque tropical islands - for an entire day from sunrise, to sunset. Filmed in 2013 by David Huting, the tiny island is hidden off of the northeastern coast of the outer Fiji Islands (near Taveuni), and boasts a perfect white sandy beach, groves of palm trees, and a majestic lagoon that shelters the island from all sides. It has more turtle visitors than humans!

programme.title: Cunningham Cabin: Grand Teton National Park

programme.title: Humpback Whales
programme.desc: Observe the humble humpback in all its glory. Few things are more majestic than a whale in its natural habitat: a gentle giant that inhabits every one of the world's oceans.

programme.title: Peaceful Forest Walk: Quebec

programme.title: Garden of Eden (Music)

programme.title: A Day in Santorini
programme.desc: Turn any screen into a window the the Greek Islands with this immensely relaxing HD visual journey through the unique and beautiful coastal village of Oia, found on the far tip of Santorini Island. Slowly awaken your senses as the morning sun rises over the sea, and watch as day slowly passes into dusk. Distant waves break and birds chirp adding an a nice ambient music that combines to create a video that's so relaxing it's almost trance-inducing.

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கால பைரவன்
programme.sub-title: Jogeshwari is the daughter of Dakshan who hates Shiva and worships Vishnu. When Dakshan forces Jogeshwari to marry, she rebels because of her dedication towards Bhairavan, a devout devotee of Shiva
programme.desc: சிவனை வெறுத்து விஷ்ணுவை வழிபடும் தட்சன், அவரது மகள் ஜோகேஸ்வரியை திருமணம் செய்ய வற்புறுத்தும்போது, அவளோ சிவனின் தீவிர பக்தரான பைரவன் மீதான தனது பக்தியின் காரணமாக எதிர்க்கிறாள்.

programme.title: அண்ணாமலை

credits.actor: Sivakumar,Radikaa Sarathkumar,Shyam Ganesh,Kuyili,Ponvannan,Viji Chandrasekhar,Shanmuga Sundaram,Jyothi Lakshmi

programme.title: தாமரை

credits.director: K.J Thangapandiyan,Hafees,A. Ramachandran,M.K. Arunthavaraja,S. Anand Babu

programme.title: Selvi
programme.desc: Selvi, a young girl, has academic ambition that she wants to pursue by moving to the city from her village. However, her family wants her to get married.

programme.title: அம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Sakthi is blessed by the Goddess Amman with the power to foresee the future. Her life takes an unexpected turn when she meets an atheist doctor
programme.desc: அம்மன் தேவியால் சக்தி எதிர்காலத்தை கணிக்கும் அருளை பெறுகிறாள். அவள் ஒரு நாத்திக மருத்துவரை சந்திக்கும்போது, அவளது வாழ்க்கை எதிர்பாராத திருப்பத்தை அடைகிறது.

programme.title: கர்ணா

programme.title: தெனாலி ராமன்

credits.actor: Krishna Bharadwaj,Pankaj Berry,Manav Gohil,Jitendra Pathak,Sohit Soni,Sanjay Mangnani,Priyamvada Kant,Nimisha Vakharia

programme.title: வானம்பாடி

programme.desc: சகோதரிகளான துளசி மற்றும் மானசியில் ஒருத்தி தங்கள் தந்தையினுடைய எதிரி மகனை மணக்கத் தீர்மானிக்கும்போது, வரவிருக்கும் சிக்கல்களுடன் கூடிய ஒரு திருப்புமுனையை அவர்கள் எதிர்கொள்கிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஆசை 100 வகை
programme.sub-title: A series of dramatised re-enactments of cases revolving around various horrifying and unscrupulous activities that conspire in society
programme.desc: சமூகத்தில் சதி செய்யும் பல்வேறு திகிலூட்டும் மற்றும் நேர்மையற்ற செயல்களைச் சுற்றியுள்ள வழக்குகளின் தொடர்ச்சியான நாடகமாக்கப்பட்ட மறு-நடவடிக்கைகள்.

programme.title: மிக்ஸ்டேப் பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of some of the most popular and beloved musical numbers from the year, played consecutively
programme.desc: வருடத்தில் மிகவும் பிரபலமான மற்றும் பிரியமான சில இசை எண்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு, தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்பட்டது.

programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: Krishna, the young son of Devaki and Vasudeva, embarks on a series of adventures where he befriends the people of Vrindavan, his hometown, and saves them from difficulties.

credits.actor: Nimai Bali,Meet Mukhi,Sachin Shroff,Deshna Dugad,Ram Awana

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கால பைரவன்
programme.sub-title: Jogeshwari is the daughter of Dakshan who hates Shiva and worships Vishnu. When Dakshan forces Jogeshwari to marry, she rebels because of her dedication towards Bhairavan, a devout devotee of Shiva
programme.desc: சிவனை வெறுத்து விஷ்ணுவை வழிபடும் தட்சன், அவரது மகள் ஜோகேஸ்வரியை திருமணம் செய்ய வற்புறுத்தும்போது, அவளோ சிவனின் தீவிர பக்தரான பைரவன் மீதான தனது பக்தியின் காரணமாக எதிர்க்கிறாள்.

programme.title: மூவி
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: திரைப்படங்களில் சிறந்தவை.

programme.title: அண்ணாமலை
programme.sub-title: Generations of rivalry come to light as two families fight for control of a revered temple while personal emotions complicate the path to peace
programme.desc: தனிப்பட்ட உணர்வுகள் அமைதிக்கான பாதையை சிக்கலாக்கும் அதே வேளையில், ஒரு புனிதமான கோவிலின் கட்டுப்பாட்டிற்காக இரண்டு குடும்பங்கள் சண்டையிடுவதால், தலைமுறையாக இருந்துவரும் அவர்களின் பகைமை வெளிச்சத்திற்கு வருகிறது.

credits.actor: Sivakumar,Radikaa Sarathkumar,Shyam Ganesh,Kuyili,Ponvannan,Viji Chandrasekhar,Shanmuga Sundaram,Jyothi Lakshmi

programme.title: தாமரை
programme.sub-title: Sneha and Dwarkesh fall in love, and they secretly register their marriage. However, their relationship is tested as they face various obstacles
programme.desc: காதலர்களான சினேகாவும் துவாரகேஷும் ரகசியமாக பதிவு திருமணம் செய்து கொள்கிறார்கள். ஆனால், அவர்கள் பல்வேறு தடைகளைச் சந்திக்கும் பொழுது அவர்களின் உறவு சோதிக்கப்படுகிறது.

credits.director: K.J Thangapandiyan,Hafees,A. Ramachandran,M.K. Arunthavaraja,S. Anand Babu

programme.title: Selvi
programme.desc: Selvi, a young girl, has academic ambition that she wants to pursue by moving to the city from her village. However, her family wants her to get married.

programme.title: அம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Sakthi is blessed by the Goddess Amman with the power to foresee the future. Her life takes an unexpected turn when she meets an atheist doctor
programme.desc: அம்மன் தேவியால் சக்தி எதிர்காலத்தை கணிக்கும் அருளை பெறுகிறாள். அவள் ஒரு நாத்திக மருத்துவரை சந்திக்கும்போது, அவளது வாழ்க்கை எதிர்பாராத திருப்பத்தை அடைகிறது.

credits.actor: Pavithra Gowda (Sakthi),Amaljith (Eshwar),Nivisha (Durga),Surjith Ansary (Kishore),Nanditha Jennifer (Saradha),Nisha Jagadeeswaran (Logambal),Shaliy Avinesh (Logambal),Shobana (Naga),Anita Nair (Lakshmi),Rathan Ganapathy (Mahendran),Avinash Ashok (Aravindh),Anu Sulash (Neha),Shubha Raksha (Inba)

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கர்ணா
programme.sub-title: Karna, the son of the Sun God and Kunti, faces hardships from birth but strives to prove his worth. Overcoming challenges, he rises to become one of the most formidable archers and warriors in the Mahabharata
programme.desc: பிறப்பிலிருந்தே பல சவால்களை தாண்டி மகாபாரதத்தில் சிறந்த வில்லாளி மற்றும் போர்வீரராகும் சூரியன், குந்தியின் மகன் கர்ணன்.

programme.title: தெனாலி ராமன்
programme.sub-title: Tenali Raman, an advisor at the court of King Krishnadevaraya, uses his sharp presence of mind and wisdom to solve the difficult matters of the kingdom and its people daily
programme.desc: தனது கூர்மையான மனதையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்தி, ராஜ்ஜியம் மற்றும் மக்களின் கடினமான விஷயங்களை தீர்க்கும் தெனாலி ராமன்.

credits.actor: Krishna Bharadwaj,Pankaj Berry,Manav Gohil,Jitendra Pathak,Sohit Soni,Sanjay Mangnani,Priyamvada Kant,Nimisha Vakharia

programme.title: பிரியாத வரம் வேண்டும்
programme.sub-title: A queen kills her son's lover who was a peasant and forces him to marry a princess of her choice. A million years later, they are reborn where the couple gets a chance to reunite
programme.desc: ஒரு ராணி தனது மகனின் காதலியை கொன்று, அவள் விரும்பும் இளவரசியை மணந்து கொள்ளும்படி வற்புறுத்துகிறாள். ஆனால், ஒரு மில்லியன் ஆண்டுகளுக்குப் பிறகு, மீண்டும் இணைவதற்கான வாய்ப்பு கிடைக்கும் இடத்தில் அவர்கள் மீண்டும் பிறக்கிறார்கள்.

programme.title: அலாதின்
programme.desc: Aladdin, a poor thief, discovers a magical lamp containing a Genie. However, soon he realizes that Zafar, an evil sorcerer, also desires the lamp to rule over Baghdad.

programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. programme.sub-title: How did Harry Houdini pull off his death-defying escapes? A team of experts investigates his illusions to reveal the secrets of this mysterious stunt
programme.desc: Cracking a magician's code used to be strictly against industry standards. Now, it seems the magic has disappeared from that concept, and even legendary performers such as Harry Houdini are not immune. This series looks to uncover the methods to Houdini's breathtaking escapes and astonishing illusions, which have never been equalled or fully understood. How did this showman catch a speeding bullet, submerge himself in a water torture cell, or survive being buried alive? programme.title: My 600-Lb. Life
programme.sub-title: Jonathan had his dream job, and he ate himself out of it. Once an EMT first responder, now he rarely leaves the room. His wife works full-time to pay their bills, and Jonathan must break the cycle of eating if he wants to keep his wife and his life
programme.desc: Telling powerful stories in hourlong episodes, TLC follows medical journeys of morbidly obese people as they attempt to save their own lives. In addition to drastically changing their appearances, they hope to reclaim their independence, mend relationships with friends and family, and renew their feelings of self-worth.

programme.desc: The gold rush in Alaska isn't confined to the state's precious ground. It's taking place on the sea ... or more accurately, on the bottom of the frigid Bering Sea.
